name_reason: Convention-compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=ui_menu stat-compare). Descriptor accurately reflects the body: picks a digit-color sprite-base by signed comparison of two stats. No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Pure 3-branch comparator that picks the digit-color sprite-base for the buy-item stat preview, comparing a char's current stat against the with-item-equipped preview stat.
logic_summary: Signed compare of two ints (asm: CMP then JNZ/JGE). current == preview -> 0x1F; current < preview -> 0x2A; current > preview -> 0x77. The leading PUSH 0x4 / CALL __CHK is the Watcom stack-probe prologue (compiler-injected, not game logic) and the decompiler's in_stack_00000000 is its artifact; both operands are reloaded from the stack frame ([ESP+4]=current, [ESP+8]=preview), so no CALL-return value is consumed and there is no EAX-tracking hazard.

params.name: current_stat
params.semantics: The char's actual current base stat for one slot (AP/DP/DX/Stat4). Caller fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview passes current_ap/current_dp/current_dx/current_stat4 read from the runtime char struct.
params.reason: Accurately names the left operand; matches caller usage; no address residue; signed int matches the asm JGE comparison.

params.name: preview_stat
params.semantics: The previewed stat the char would have with the candidate item equipped (computed by fd2_compute_equipped_stats_with_item_preview), compared against current_stat to pick the color.
params.reason: Accurately names the right operand; matches caller usage; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Digit-color sprite-base index forwarded as the color arg to fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer: 0x1F (equal/no-change), 0x2A (current<preview), 0x77 (current>preview).

notes: Source comment in shop.c (lines 23-44) is already precise, ASCII, and correct: it documents the 3-branch mapping, honestly flags the counter-intuitive 0x2A/0x77 color semantics as matching the original, and explains that __CHK is compiler-injected with no EAX hazard. Disassembly verified: signed CMP/JGE, operands reloaded from stack, values 0x1F/0x2A/0x77. Ghidra plate is consistent with the refined understanding (more verbose but not contradictory), so plate left untouched. Color names (red/white/orange) are interpretive but not load-bearing and consistent across src and plate. No src edit needed (comment_verdict=keep). The 'would decrease'/'would increase' wording is the original's intent per the verbatim mapping and is retained as-is, not asserted as a new verified claim.
